name: Sky Footer
summary: A footer that is a sky: layered cloud sprites drift and parallax at different depths over a day or night gradient, with a giant brand wordmark rendered as fluffy cloud above link columns and a legal line.
useWhen: A landing page needs a memorable, atmospheric closing footer with the brand name as the centerpiece
The site supports light and dark themes and should switch between a day and a night sky
avoidWhen: The footer must stay compact or text-dense; the cloud band takes about 400px of height
The brand word is long, because the wordmark is squeezed to fit one line
